Body moves coherently, head stable, independent tail/fin motion. Actual alpha transparent background. No scenery, water, cast shadow, particles, glow, text, labels, frame outlines, logos or interface. No cropping. No fragments of another character. Central placement and large fully transparent gutters are more important than filling the canvas.
